input: Scheduled: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products in production; merge when done.
task: Deepen (flagship 12) ids-model-check: model fill writes Qto_ quantities measured from geometry (ifc-quantity-takeoff) when no set holds them

doc_friction.issue: --replace with a NEW text on --field buildable reported 'keep: (nothing; cut the clause)' and refused (exit 1) with no stated reason; a shorter NEW worked. Unclear which rule tripped.

goal: Revit-style exports with no quantity sets get Qto_ values written from geometry, with the measured error stated
notes: Checks run here: node --test geometry-quantities.test.mjs page.test.mjs (9 pass); python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py ids-model-check (454 tests ok, 2 skipped) before the page wiring, rerun after; Chromium on a local --only build: page checkbox writes 3 wall NetSideArea values, failing 3->0. Sweep on 4 real exports x 69 IDS with geometry: 3,048 values measured and written, all read back passing; IfcTester 0.9.0 6,470 written values pass, 0 newly failing. Measured vs stored on HHS Office: 3,666 of 3,858 within 2%, 190 of the other 192 traced to stored-value faults.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a BIM tools developer wiring a takeoff engine into an IFC writer, plus a 4-model x 69-IDS validation with IfcTester and a write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
